'''Masami Iwasaki''' (Japanese: '''岩崎征実''' ''Iwasaki Masami'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Iwasaki was born on October 25, 1971, in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actor as an adult. In [[Pokémon animation]], he first voiced [[Opelucid City]] [[Gym Leader]] [[Drayden]] in [[Pokémon Generations]]. He then joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|SM}}, where he voiced [[Mad Magmar]], a member of the antagonistic [[Revengers]]. Iwasaki tends to be cast in the roles of minions or ruffians.
